notes.title: Update notice
notes.content:
[h2]Update details[/h2]

[h3]▼New Hero “Reklam of Collapse” added[/h3]
An alchemist from the alchemy country "Grimsta".
He has unique skills that allow him to attack behind himself and block enemy movements.
Please enjoy a different experience from previous Heroes.
("Reklam of Collapse" will be unlocked by clearing it 4 times or more)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229902/a98405e77562061ee205dd0ae118e34cfaadef3b.png[/img]


[h3]▼Reroll function added[/h3]
It is now possible to re-draw skills that were drawn during Level Up.
The redraw can be used up to two times, and the number of uses can be recovered at the inn.
Enjoy more flexible skill selection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229902/8270092c72b34c43ef88778455691e23b64ae55a.png[/img]

[h3]▼Adjustment of each MAP function[/h3]
You can now check the number of relics and BOSS in each dungeon on the MAP.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229902/2bcfe20bbe073925085713b0bdc99c2bfddb1726.png[/img]

The MiniMap display area within the dungeon has been expanded.
Enjoy more comfortable adventures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229902/57d0258097ce37b59a5b47363b349e86ef2e9536.png[/img]

[h3]▼Regional design adjustment[/h3]
Adjusted the design of some areas.
You can enjoy the world view of "Lazarus" even more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229902/48fb1b29603559abc92985bba94a682598f80857.png[/img]

[h3]▼Equipment buff effect adjustment[/h3]
Increased the effect value of some buffs.

[h3]▼Adjustment of experience points and coin output[/h3]
Experience points and coins are now also dropped when acquiring "relics".

[h3]▼Title and opening design adjustment[/h3]
Adjusted the design of the title screen at the start of the game and the opening at the start of the adventure.

[h3]▼Added information in “Game Description”[/h3]
Added "-Adventure objective-" to "Game description".

[h3]▼Bug fixes[/h3]
Fixed some bugs.
